## Description and Rationale

Who I am:
Solo participant based in the US, working in a data/process-analysis role with a strong SQL and applied analytics background.

Why I registered:
I wanted a real-world regression problem with genuine complexity, not a toy dataset — taxi-out time prediction fits well. Not chasing the prize; mainly here to build a rigorous, well-documented model and learn the aviation ops domain along the way.
